    Profile

    Tina is the 45th chief of the Toxotes tribe, a Voda people from the Saga Region. She lives away from the rest of the tribe, deep in the midst of nature, and is unfamiliar with the present situation in Saga. She's a wary person, but isn't cold to everyone, and can be very gentle towards animals and children. Her hawk companion's name is Badalf.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 156cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Feb 1
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Wind Goddess
    Likes: Her comrades
    Hobbies: Playing with animals and children, climbing trees
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 生天目仁美
